name: Niji semi realism
description: Niji Semi-realism V4.0 updated on 17/4/2026 This version is basically the upgraded edition of the LoRA — I fed it more images, switched the base model, upgraded the tagging system . Result? It got smarter… and a bit picky 😏 I also split it into 3 personalities (styles), each with its own trigger word. So yeah… you’re not dealing with one LoRA anymore, you’re dealing with a whole squad. The Styles (choose your fighter) 1. SemiFrealism (F = Flat) This one loves flat colors like anime and cartoons. Clean, simple, and straight to the point — no extra drama. Honestly, this is the favorite child of the LoRA. 2. SemiRrealism (R = Realistic) Wants everything to look realistic and detailed. Photorealistic? 3D? Fancy lighting? Say less. This one tries a bit too hard to be real… but it works. 3. SemiNrealism (N = Normal) The chill middle child. Not too flat, not too realistic — just vibing in between. This is the default mood if you don’t pick a side. Important stuff (read this or suffer 😭) If the result looks weird… it’s not the LoRA, it’s you 💀 Add proper keywords. The model is smart, but not a mind reader. Don’t just spam one style and expect magic — experiment like a normal human. Final warning ⚠️ This LoRA is powerful… but only if you know how to talk to it. Treat it right, and it’ll cook 🔥 Use bad prompts… and it will absolutely embarrass you. v2 update on 1/6/2025 I used approximately a lot of niji v6 style image, the pictures were with style called pseudo-realistic and semi-realism so i tried to focus on this 2 style Style features : Niji v6 style used high quality image used Style distinguishes between night and day Add dark lighting style and reflections maybe you can use trigger word like : to get realistic result pseudo-realistic, semi-realism, realism, realistic to get night time color theory, darkness, night, night time to get cartoon like style cartoon, lineless, flat color
